title: Make mailbox send-time dispatch and current wake/acknowledgement status clear
outcome: One current-state lookup through the existing termal_read_mailbox_message / CLI read-message route, plus clear at-send receipt wording; not a new wake/retry feature
acceptance: Send results and API/tool/CLI guidance explicitly distinguish the immutable at-send receipt from current state, and never equate durableButNotWoken with failed delivery or append success with recipient delivery.

The existing exact-message lookup returns a consistent, timestamped current wake/recipient-acknowledgement projection with shared plain-language meaning across supported local and remote routes; unavailable remote state stays explicitly unavailable, and no new lifecycle storage or mandatory extra read is introduced.

Tests using the actual existing producer/consumer paths demonstrate unchanged idempotent receipts after wake advancement, current lookup after queued/delivered/recipient-ACK transitions (including ACK without wake), sender-cursor isolation, remote-unavailable versus later supported read, and unchanged page-ACK/access controls; existing exact-input review and full-gate requirements apply.
